sources.title: The Agentic Loop Closes · Agent Brief
sources.snippet: This is the week the agentic web stopped being a metaphor and started being a training signal. Grok 4.6 launched as the first frontier model trained on internal model-development tasks — not just chat logs, but actual agent work.
